records.name: 1791 Delegates
records.summary: A nonprofit with offices in Philadelphia, New York and Washington, DC. It offers online courses on religious literacy and public life, and classroom materials on rights and respect for schools.
records.what_you_do: Take an online course or join the learning community at ReligionAndPublicLife.org. Ask about other programs through the group's contact page.

first_step.how: Browse the online courses at ReligionAndPublicLife.org, or use the contact page to ask about programs.
first_step.basis: Courses are online and the learning site lists over 2,000 members, but the group's own page gives no sign-up steps.

records.notes: Mostly national and online programs, with Philadelphia as one of three office locations. The site gives no dates and no street address, so status comes from a working site with no dates. Owner should decide whether a national online course provider belongs in a Philadelphia directory.

records.name: 5th Square
records.notes: The IRS filing lists cpuf.org as this group's website, but that site belongs to the Center for Philadelphia's Urban Future, a fiscal sponsor with a different name. Its listed projects (Code for Philly, Open Data Philly, Save the Academy) do not include 5th Square, so the link was not used. No page for 5th Square was found. Its search was not used because both searches went to the two groups with no web address. IRS address: 700 S 7th St, Philadelphia 19147. Held back: no summary or category yet.

records.name: A Drop in the Ocean
records.notes: IRS legal name: A Drop in the Ocean Inc. The site gives the same EIN (82-1927041). It names two contacts, with an email hidden on the page and a US phone number, and gives no street address and no description of Philadelphia work. Its volunteer page and social links point to a Norwegian site (drapenihavet.no). The IRS filing lists 422 Green St, Philadelphia 19123. Service area not confirmed. Held back until someone can say what it does and where.

records.name: Academy at Palumbo Home and School Association
records.notes: Home and school association for the Academy at Palumbo, so hidden under the brief's rule for booster groups serving one school. The site could not be read (certificate error on the bare domain and on www). The domain name includes 'griffins', so the association may cover a second school too. If it serves parents of more than one school, or if the owner wants parent groups listed, reconsider. IRS address: 1100 Catharine St, Philadelphia 19147.

records.name: African Bicycle Contribution
records.notes: The site returned no content on two tries (www and bare domain), so nothing about its work, location or events was read. No search was used on this group (both searches went to groups with no web address). IRS address: 2000 Hamilton Street, Philadelphia 19130. Held back until the site can be read or a second source is found.

records.name: Philadelphia Area Group Psychotherapy Society
records.summary: A membership society for people who lead therapy groups in the Philadelphia region. Its monthly Consultation Group gives clinicians a place to talk through their group work.
records.what_you_do: Bring your group clinical work to the monthly Consultation Group, or join the society for member rates and benefits.

schedule.text: Monthly Consultation Group, with a 2026 to 2027 schedule running from September 9, 2026 to May 12, 2027

cost.text: $15 for members and $25 for non-members for the Consultation Group, as listed on the group's site

first_step.how: Register for a Consultation Group session at pagps.org/consultation-group, or join the society through pagps.org/join.
first_step.basis: The Consultation Group is open to anyone who works with groups and has a clear register link, but the page does not mention beginners.

records.notes: Philadelphia-area affiliate of the national American Group Psychotherapy Association. The batch's IRS name (American Group Psychotherapy Association Inc, 632 N 2nd St Unit 590) may be this society's legal entity, but the site does not give its legal name, so the EIN is not written in the match. The facilitator's personal email on the page is not recorded.

records.name: American Legion Post 405
records.summary: A veterans post that meets once a month at the Union League of Philadelphia. Its site also lists local events, including the Philadelphia Veterans Parade and a yearly dinner gala.
records.what_you_do: Ask the post about membership, or buy a ticket to the yearly dinner gala. Ask whether guests can sit in on a monthly meeting.

schedule.text: Meets on the third Monday of each month at 6 PM

cost.text: Gala tickets are $120. Meeting cost and dues are not listed.

first_step.how: Email the post to ask about membership, or go to a third Monday meeting at 6 PM.
first_step.basis: The page does not say what membership requires, what dues cost, or whether meetings are open to non-members.

records.notes: Batch name was 'American Legion'. The site gives the footer address 140 South Broad Street and says the post is associated with the Union League of Philadelphia. It lists an upcoming Annual Dinner Gala on Friday, November 6, 2026, with limited reservations. Last sign of life is the Philadelphia Veterans Parade listing (Sunday, November 9, 2025). The Officers and Members page was not read, so membership eligibility is unknown.

records.name: Kantaya
records.notes: Peruvian nonprofit running an after-school program for children in Peru. Its phone number is a Peru number, and the site does not mention Philadelphia. Legal name: Asociacion Kantaya Inc. The IRS filing lists 1600 Arch St Apt 801, Philadelphia 19103.

records.name: Association for Preservation Technology, Delaware Valley Chapter
records.summary: A regional chapter of a professional group for people who restore and care for historic buildings. It covers Pennsylvania, southern New Jersey and northern Delaware, and holds about one event a month.
records.what_you_do: Join the chapter to take part in its talks and tours on preservation methods and materials, and watch for the symposium planned for October.

first_step.how: Use the Join today page (apt-dvc.org/membership) to join, then watch the events list for the next talk or tour.
first_step.basis: Membership is the stated way in, and the page does not say whether non-members can attend events.

records.notes: Chapter of the national Association for Preservation Technology, with about 300 members. The newest item is the May 2026 newsletter (dated May 31, 2026). The page showed no upcoming events when read. Membership categories and dues were not listed.

records.name: Brave Connections
records.notes: Nonprofit founded by Rebecca Chalson that runs Veteran Concierge, a resource service the site describes as nationwide. The site names no Philadelphia location, no local groups and no dated events. The IRS filing lists 1900 Arch St Apt 1007, Philadelphia 19103. Marked out of area because the work is national. Reconsider if a local program appears.

records.name: Bridges 2030 International
records.notes: The batch website field was the name 'Bridges 2030', not a web address, so it was treated as missing. One search for the name with Philadelphia found no organization of that name; the results were about bridges in general. The IRS address, 632 North 2nd Street, is the same street address as American Group Psychotherapy Association Inc in this batch. Held back until a web page or a second source is found.

records.name: Center City Eruv Corporation
records.notes: Maintains the Center City eruv boundary. The site is current (last updated Friday, August 28, 2026) and offers a public boundary map, an address checker and email status alerts. It says volunteers inspect and repair the boundary each week, but gives no sign-up route, no contact details and no events list, so a newcomer has no public way in. Hidden as private. The owner may want a listing for the map and alerts. The batch address was centercityeruv.org, which redirects to centercityeruv.com.

records.name: Center for Media and Destiny
records.notes: The site could not be read. Both mediaanddestiny.org and www.mediaanddestiny.org returned a certificate name mismatch (the server presents a hosting provider's certificate). Nothing about its work or events was read. The IRS address is 1352 South St Unit 501, Philadelphia 19147. Held back until the site can be read.

records.name: Children First Action Fund
records.summary: A Pennsylvania advocacy group that pushes lawmakers to invest in children living with poverty and hardship. It publishes election guides and candidate questionnaire answers so families can see where officials stand.
records.what_you_do: Read the election guides and candidate answers, sign up for updates through the group's website, or join the Child Care Voters Facebook group.

first_step.how: Sign up through the 'Be a Part of the Action' page on the group's website to get updates.
first_step.basis: Open to the public, and the site lists several ways to sign up or join online.

records.notes: IRS name in the batch: Children First Action Fund, with 'Children Matter Inc' as an alias. IRS address: 990 Spring Garden St Ste 600, Philadelphia 19123. Partisanship check: the site says it works in a nonpartisan way with bipartisan volunteers, but it also hosts a 2026 ballot guide, an election center and candidate questionnaire answers. No PAC or endorsement language was found. Owner should confirm the nonpartisan call before this goes live. The two social links belong to the Child Care Voters campaign, per the page. The site shows no dated posts, so status is a working-site judgment.

records.name: Citizens for Responsible Care and Research
records.summary: A national human rights group that works to protect people in medical research and treatment, with a focus on children, older adults and people who cannot make their own decisions. It works through policy papers, public comments and testimony.
records.what_you_do: Read the policy papers on the group's site, and use its contact page to ask how to get involved. Donations are taken through its support page.

first_step.how: Read the policy papers on circare.org, then use the contact page to ask how to get involved.
first_step.basis: The site lists no membership, meetings or volunteer roles, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The site says it was last updated August 9, 2016, and its newest dated document is from February 29, 2016, so status is dormant. The IRS filing lists 1024 N 5th St, Philadelphia 19123, but the site gives no location. Batch name: Citizens for Responsible Care & Research Inc.

leads_only.name: Save the Academy
leads_only.note: Named on the Center for Philadelphia's Urban Future page as a volunteer campaign to keep the Academy of Natural Sciences museum open. No own URL seen.

returned empty content on two tries (www and bare domain)
TLS certificate name mismatch on two tries (bare domain and www)
page returned only its title on two tries (www and bare domain); retry later

notes: Budget: 2 of 2 WebSearch calls used, both on the two groups with no usable web address (Children First Action Fund, Bridges 2030 International). 25 WebFetch calls used of 60. 5th Square's listed site belongs to another organization, so it needed a search too, but the budget was already spent. No rate limiting seen; failures were TLS errors and empty pages. Verdict counts: publish 11 (of which 5 are held back for lack of summary and category: 5th Square, A Drop in the Ocean, African Bicycle Contribution, Bridges 2030 International, Center for Media and Destiny), hide 2, out_of_area 2. Leads from the Center for Philadelphia's Urban Future page: Code for Philly returned only its title on two tries (in blocked, worth a retry later). Open Data Philly was read and dropped: it is a data catalog with no volunteer, event or join route. Save the Academy has no URL of its own in the source, so it stays in leads_only. Groups named on the 1791 Delegates and American Legion pages were dropped without a fetch: First Amendment Watch (NYU), the National Interfaith Anti-Bullying Summit and Parliament of the World's Religions (national or global, not Philadelphia), Temple Israel in Manchester NH (out of area), The Foundation for Religious Literacy and Mount America Foundation (foundations named on other pages, not checked), and the Philadelphia Veterans Parade (one event, not a group). ReligionAndPublicLife.org is part of 1791 Delegates.
